# Zenda legal documents

Public GitHub Pages site for the Zenda app's Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and
Health Disclaimer: https://usezenda.github.io/legal/

**Do not edit the three document files here.** The canonical sources live in the
private `UseZenda/Zenda` repository under `docs/legal/`, and are regenerated into this
repo by `scripts/legal/publish-site.sh` there. Only the Jekyll layout (`_layouts/`,
`_config.yml`, `index.md`) is authored in this repo.
